title: Phil Foden Signs Four-Year Contract Extension With Manchester City Until 2030
excerpt: The academy graduate commits his future to his boyhood club under new manager Enzo Maresca, ending months of transfer speculation.
body:
Key Takeaways
  • Phil Foden signed a four-year contract extension with Manchester City until 2030.
  • Foden is the most decorated player in City's history, with significant wage increase from £225,000 per week.
  • He struggled last season with 10 goals and 7 assists in 50 appearances.
  • New manager Enzo Maresca's arrival influenced Foden's decision to stay at City.
  • Manchester City begins their season under Maresca on August 23 against Bournemouth.

Academy Product Stays Home

Manchester City on Wednesday confirmed that Phil Foden has signed a four-year contract extension that ties the midfielder to his boyhood club until 2030, with an option for a further year. The deal ends months of speculation about Foden's future, with Barcelona and AC Milan among the clubs reportedly interested in the England international.

Foden, 26, negotiated the deal through Erling Haaland's agent Rafaela Pimenta and is believed to have secured a significant increase on his previous £225,000-per-week wages, according to The Sun, despite two difficult seasons by his own elevated standards.

"Committing my future to City means everything to me. Playing for this club is all I've ever wanted to do and it's always an honour to wear the shirt."

— Phil Foden, Manchester City midfielder

A Turbulent Period Behind Him

The contract comes at a pivotal moment in Foden's career. The 2023-24 Premier League Player of the Season has struggled to replicate that form, registering 10 goals and seven assists in 50 appearances last season. He started only seven of City's last 26 matches before Pep Guardiola's departure at the end of the season, and was omitted from England's World Cup squad by manager Thomas Tuchel after a dip in form in 2026.

A year ago, Foden opened up publicly about his battles with mental health, a period that coincided with his drop in on-field performance. Despite this, he remains the most decorated player in Manchester City's history alongside former teammates Bernardo Silva and John Stones, both of whom left the club during the close season.

Foden has made 411 appearances and scored 131 goals since breaking into the first team under Guardiola in 2017, winning six Premier League titles, the Champions League, two FA Cups, and five League Cups.

![Enzo Maresca. New manager Enzo Maresca's arrival influenced Foden's decision to stay at City.](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/a/a4/Enzo_maresca_chelsea_gent_2024_%28extracted%29.jpg)

Maresca Factor

A key factor in Foden's decision to stay appears to be the arrival of new manager Enzo Maresca. The Italian, a former City academy manager, served as Guardiola's assistant during the 2022-23 treble-winning campaign — the season in which Foden took a significant leap in his output. Maresca was handpicked as City's successor to Guardiola and officially took charge in June.

"So excited. Obviously, I've had Enzo before. When we had him in the Treble season, he was brilliant," Foden said. "His attention to detail, the small things that make a big difference. Even training with him at the moment, you can tell how good of a coach he is."

![Erling Haaland. Photo: Wikimedia Commons](https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/4/43/Erling_Haaland_Morocco_v_Norway_7_June_2026-51.jpg)

Looking Ahead

Manchester City begin their Premier League campaign under Maresca on August 23 against Bournemouth. For the millions of Premier League fans across India and the Indian diaspora, Foden's commitment to City provides stability at a club navigating its biggest managerial transition in a decade. The Premier League remains one of the most-watched sporting leagues in India, with an estimated 150 million viewers, and City's new chapter under Maresca will be closely followed.
